invariants.rationale: The method returns a non-null HoodieData object wrapping the tagged records.
Input parameter 'records' must be non-null for the method to operate.
If input 'records' is empty, the resulting tagged data should also be empty; otherwise, there should be some records.
The tagging operation maintains the same number of records as the input.
The result should have at most as many records as the input.
